description: aifactory-code guards. Command guard: denies reckless shell commands and asks a person before destructive ones. Protected files guard: asks a person before a change to CI, deployment or infrastructure configuration that is already in the repository. Secret guard: blocks writing .env files and secret-shaped values. Code guard, inside AI Factory projects only: blocks infrastructure code, direct AI providers and unsafe code shapes (AF-09, AF-19, AF-31).
